CircuitFluid.title: CircuitFluid
CircuitFluid.description:
Fluid of one circuit: every port connected to `anchor` through connections and enabled
channels (closed valves included). Circuits without an entry use Project.fluid.

CircuitInfo.title: CircuitInfo
CircuitInfo.description: One fluid circuit of a compiled project: its fluid and the ports it contains.

ControlPreviewResponse.title: ControlPreviewResponse
ControlPreviewResponse.description: `POST /controls/preview`：一次 initialize+step 的拟写入值，不产生运行档案。

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: 结构化错误 `detail`：服务端主动抛出的 code/message，可带诊断与定位字段。

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
HTTP 错误响应包络。

运行时 FastAPI 统一输出 `{"detail": …}`：`detail` 可能是结构化错误（`ErrorDetail`）、
纯文本说明，或请求校验问题列表。本模型只用于 OpenAPI 文档化，不改变运行时响应体。

FluidConfig.title: FluidConfig
FluidConfig.description: Serializable fluid selection passed to the property service.

ModuleDefinition.title: ModuleDefinition
ModuleDefinition.description: Schema-dispatched module facade; v1 never receives SDK default fields.

ModuleDesignRequest.title: ModuleDesignRequest
ModuleDesignRequest.description: Run design.py once on one library-value set; nothing is stored.

ModuleTestAssertion.title: ModuleTestAssertion
ModuleTestAssertion.description: An author's expected final-frame value, expressed in canonical units.

ProjectUpgradeResponse.title: ProjectUpgradeResponse
ProjectUpgradeResponse.description: `POST /project-upgrades/preview`：版本差异与兼容性结论；兼容时附升级后的项目。

RefpropInfo.title: RefpropInfo
RefpropInfo.description: `GET /health` 上报的 REFPROP 运行时发现结果（不加载 DLL）。

RunOverviewResponse.title: RunOverviewResponse
RunOverviewResponse.description: Every `stride`-th frame of the whole run (≤ ~2000 rows) plus the latest frame.

SavedProjectRunRequest.title: SavedProjectRunRequest
SavedProjectRunRequest.description: Run a persisted project snapshot; the server supplies its actual revision.

ScheduleEvent.title: ScheduleEvent
ScheduleEvent.description:
A load or operation event at a simulation time (cold-store projects; canonical units).

door_heat: `heat_w` for `duration_s` [time_s, time_s + duration_s); goods_addition: `mass_kg` frozen goods
at `temperature_k`, mixed by energy; ambient_temperature: outdoor `temperature_k` from `time_s` on;
electric_defrost: start one defrost cycle of the target cooler; set_variable: write `value` to `key`
(`<instance>.param.<runtime parameter>` or `controller.<id>.setpoint|manual_output`) like a run command.
`instance_id` may be omitted when the project has exactly one matching device (ambient: every device
with an outdoor temperature).

ThermalCoupling.title: ThermalCoupling
ThermalCoupling.description: A storage-free single-phase coil immersed in a saturated refrigerant vessel.

TimeStepOptions.title: TimeStepOptions
TimeStepOptions.description:
Euler 时间步误差控制（A0；计划 §12.1）。

默认关闭，关闭时按 `SolverOptions.dynamic_step_s` 固定步长推进，旧项目与旧默认完全不变。
开启后每次整步试算都要用两个半步做局部截断误差估计；容差按单位分开，不用一个裸数混合 kg/J/K。

UnitWorkpointRequest.title: UnitWorkpointRequest
UnitWorkpointRequest.description: Condensing-unit bench (cold-store case): one cycle point at given saturation temperatures (K).

ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue
ValidationIssue.description: FastAPI/Pydantic 请求校验失败时 `detail` 列表中的一项（字段随错误类型变化）。

VariableWrite.title: VariableWrite
VariableWrite.description: POST /runs/{id}/variables: values by frame key, all applied at one frame boundary or none.

WorkspaceResponse.title: WorkspaceResponse
WorkspaceResponse.description: `GET /workspace`：最新（或指定修订）完整工作区；未保存时 revision=0、data=null。
